row.team_price_text: Starting at $50/mo (Accounting & CFO firm wholesale plan, per client)
row.evidence: Jirav's help centre has admins add users by email and role in Settings > Users and remove them by hand; sign-in is via Google, Microsoft or Xero accounts, with no SAML, SCIM or user API documented.
row.notes: No SCIM, SAML or public API found. 'SSO' on Jirav means social sign-in with Google, Microsoft or Xero accounts (not customer-IdP SAML/OIDC), so sso_plan is null. Business (SMB) pricing is quote-only; the only listed prices are the Accounting & CFO firm wholesale plans (Controller Essentials from $50/mo, CFO Enterprise from $150/mo), flat per client rather than per user. No Okta OIN page or Microsoft Entra gallery tutorial found. Status none by absence (medium confidence).

plans.name: Controller Essentials (Accounting & CFO firms)
plans.notes: Wholesale plan for accounting firms; up to 15 end-client Admin/Editor users plus unlimited read-only users. Sign-in via Google, Microsoft, Xero only.

plans.name: Safari plans (businesses)
plans.notes: SMB pricing page lists features but no plan names or prices.

scim.notes: No SCIM documentation found on jirav.com or help.jirav.com.

user_api.notes: No public API or developer docs found.

okta.notes: https://www.okta.com/integrations/jirav/ returned 404 and the Okta sitemap has no Jirav integration.

entra.notes: No Jirav tutorial in the Microsoft Entra SaaS app tutorial TOC.

fallbacks.notes: Users are invited manually by an Admin; social sign-in with Google, Microsoft or Xero accounts.

Business (Safari) plan names and prices are not public.
